newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian stock exchange issues data on trading.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian stock exchange issues data on trading.

text.p: The Palestinian stock market, in its first official report on weekly activities, said on Wednesday that 45,255 shares worth more than 75,000 Jordanian dinars ($53,000) were traded on Tuesday.
The Palestine Securities Exchange (PSE) said in a news release that shares in eight companies among 26 already listed on the exchange were traded on Tuesday.
It said 22,000 shares were traded in the newly established Palestine International Bank and 21,000 shares in the Palestine Telecommunications Company.

"Even though the volume of trading is still limited, there are many investors who are demanding data to be published and we cannot stay much longer without publishing data," said PSE Director Safwan Bataina.
But he said the PSE would still refrain from publishing an index "until there was enough liquidity and once the number of companies trading on the exchange reaches 15".
Bataina said the $2 million fully electronic bourse, which opened in February with one weekly trading session, planned to add more sessions by the end of July.
